name: jQuery UI DateRangePicker Widget - Field Type
description: Provides a jQuery UI Date Range Picker field type, with a widget, formatter and Views filter/sort handlers.
project_description: The field-type sub-module of the jQuery UI DateRangePicker Widget project. Adds a 'daterangepicker' field type that stores a JSON {start,end} date range in a 255-character varchar column, plus a default widget (the jQuery UI date range picker), a default formatter (configurable PHP date format and range separator), and Views filter and sort handlers that reason over the range with JSON_EXTRACT. Requires the base daterangepickerwidget module.
